_: Channel summaries, generated. Keyed by repo, then a hash of the channel's source notes + tools/release-notes-prompt.md + the model (see channel_key in sync-releases.py). Written by tools/summarize-notes.py in the GitHub Action (model = the Claude model that wrote it) or by hand (model "hand"). Edit "bullets" freely: an entry is kept until its channel's notes change. "fold": true adds the closing "Plus smaller fixes and polish" line. An entry with "failed" is ignored by the page and asked again after 7 days; delete it to try sooner. Keep this file valid JSON: while it does not parse, nothing is summarized.

bullets: **Image generation** — ask for a picture and you get one; it runs on your Mac, or a cloud key or the free community cloud fills in
**Model downloads** — the bar counts what you actually started and names what is moving, with the preset matching your disk marked
**Enable visual effects** in Settings › About replaces performance mode, and now switches only the moving backdrop
**Check for updates automatically** — on, it checks at launch and once a day; off, nothing checks until you press the button
**Windows** — the app starts, chats, searches the web, reads answers aloud and takes voice input on Intel, AMD and ARM PCs, with Ollama installed for you
**Video** — ask for a short clip and it renders on your Mac, with a color-coded size ladder showing what each quality costs
**Export to twenty formats** — ask for a PDF, Word document, spreadsheet, slides, calendar file or CSV and a download box appears
**Models** — newer versions offered after each app update, outdated ones cleared, and the right cloud model picked per job
**Removed** — Contribute and the free community image cloud
**Backdrops** — dark clips play from sunset to sunrise where you are, rather than leaning on New York
The backdrop shelf now keeps unseen clips of both kinds
**Server setup** — first run can set up your server on DigitalOcean end to end, or take your own server's keys
**DNS** — NextDNS is optional at first run; without it DNS runs encrypted via Cloudflare, and Settings can flush the cache
**Automatic speed test** — Performance mode measures once the exit is verified, on network changes and every 30 minutes
**Updates** — checked at each launch and offered in a dialog with Skip, with release notes in About and a channel in Settings
**Kill switch** — nothing gets around the tunnel while it's up, with a self-test that tells blocked from broken
**Full test** — measures the direct line and each transport, and says whether the VPN or your line is the limit
**Servers** — OS updates from the app, a warning on a server that isn't answering, and adds or removes take effect at once
**Speed limits** — set the line yourself or let Auto pick; Performance and Ultra race transports and take the fastest
**Auto** — the Direct row shows at the top of the tests again, and stays there after a relaunch
